title: [反馈 3/3] 本机建议收件箱：增量去重、状态整理与可选定时拉取
scope: Issue 461 only. Isolated loopback PostgreSQL/API and a temporary user-scope scheduled task; no sibling repository or production service changed.

acceptance_criteria.actual: 202 isolated records were retained under 202 unique (site_key, feedback_id) keys; a post-fix browser receipt was read from PostgreSQL and appeared in both local reports.

Unit simulations covered pagination writes, lower-ID late commits, retry from cursor 0, isolated site failure, JSON/Markdown write failures, mark rollback behavior and concurrent writers. Pull remains GET-only.

acceptance_criteria.validation: V3 real management API evidence plus post-fix local failure tests
acceptance_criteria.actual: Real mark success was read back from the server; invalid and insufficient credentials returned their contract exit codes; failed marks preserved local bytes; intake-disabled history remained readable and manageable.

Help, JSON schema/envelope, exit codes and idempotency passed; a disabled-by-default independent task ran once on schedule, generated the matching report, then stayed disabled across the next due time.

validations.phase: real isolated run on pre-fix source; preserved historical evidence
validations.environment: Two loopback-only isolated PostgreSQL 16.15-backed services, site-a and site-b; 101 records per site, same timestamp per site, one shared feedback UUID across sites.
operations: Configured two isolated site identities and credentials by environment-variable name.
Ran feedback pull twice with --json, then listed the cache and compared exact source/local sets and server status.
validations.expected: All records retained once per site/feedback UUID, exact source key set, repeat pull idempotent, server status unchanged.
validations.actual: 202 cached rows; 202 unique composite keys; zero duplicates; full source key set matched; repeat outcome no_new_data; all V1 statuses were new.
validations.limitation: One later explicit mark changed status and updated_at for one browser record after this snapshot; the original comparison file preserves that chronology.

validations.phase: post-fix repeatable unit simulations; user authorized simulation for fault cases
validations.environment: Isolated local test fixtures; no production service.
validations.expected: Failure and recovery cases preserve records, statuses, per-site last-success evidence and JSON contracts; failures return nonzero.
validations.actual: The focused suite passed 46 tests. The combined CLI regression passed 50 tests. Simulated cases covered new writes during pagination, late lower-ID commits, connection retry, partial site outage, atomic page write failure, Markdown failure, failed mark writes and overlapping writers.

validations.phase: real isolated API/CLI run on pre-fix source; post-fix report-write failure covered by V2 regression tests
validations.environment: Isolated PostgreSQL 16.15-backed site-a/site-b APIs; synthetic management credentials stored only in temporary environment variables.
operations: Marked the real site-a feedback UUID reviewed, then verified content and reviewed status through the admin GET readback.
With public intake disabled, marked the same site-a record closed and verified closed through the admin GET readback.
Tested an ambiguous cross-site UUID, a missing/invalid credential, and a separate credential that reached the endpoint but lacked permission.
validations.expected: Successful mark state matches server GET readback; ambiguous, authentication and permission failures return distinct nonzero contract codes; intake disable does not remove historical administration.
validations.actual: The first real mark returned reviewed and api-get-readback.json confirmed reviewed. With intake disabled, the admin PATCH returned closed and admin GET confirmed closed. Exit codes were 2 for ambiguous identity, 3 for missing/invalid authentication, and 4 for insufficient permission. The initial permission test attempt lacked a valid credential and returned authentication; the separate retry file contains the actual permission error.

evidence.meaning: Admin GET confirms the real record status reviewed after the first mark.
Successful CLI mark response for reviewed.
With intake disabled, admin PATCH/GET succeeds with closed and local pull/list remain available.
Exit 2 for ambiguous same UUID across sites.
Initial setup attempt; result is authentication failure, not permission denial. Preserved as historical evidence.
Exit 4 and error.code=permission for valid credential lacking permission.
Local report after successful status management.

validations.environment: Local browser on 127.0.0.1:15161; isolated PostgreSQL 16.15 container on loopback 127.0.0.1:55461; isolated FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:8000; Windows Task Scheduler under current non-elevated user, Limited/Interactive, separate temporary task AIActuarial-FeedbackInbox-postfix-v4-41ca041a.
operations: Submitted synthetic feedback through the browser after the temporary task was registered disabled.
Verified the receipt and exact content in isolated PostgreSQL feedback_items.
Enabled only the temporary task and allowed its registered timer to invoke python -m ai_actuarial --config <feedback-sites.yaml> feedback pull --json.
Disabled the temporary task after the first successful scheduled run, waited past the next due time, and compared task state, LastRunTime, CLI/report hashes and timestamps.
validations.expected: The scheduled task fires at its registered trigger with exit 0; reports contain the same receipt ID and text; after disable, no next run changes LastRunTime or reports.

actual.content: Issue 461 post-fix scheduled acceptance: browser feedback should reach JSON and Markdown after the task trigger.

limitations: Task Scheduler Operational event logging was already disabled and was left unchanged.
A first text comparison differed only in zero fractional-second display; the retained diagnostic and UTC tick comparison confirm the same LastRunTime instant.
No production deployment or formal recurring task was enabled.
